_disclaimer: Prototype recommendation — not official emergency guidance. Pre-authored text keyed by <RISK_LEVEL>_<top_dynamic_factor>.
LOW_rainfall: Light or no rainfall. Conditions within normal range for this zone. Routine monitoring only.
LOW_forecast: Dry now; forecast rainfall is minor. No action needed. Check back if the forecast strengthens.
LOW_water_level: Simulated water level is near baseline. No action needed. (Water level is a SIMULATED input.)
LOW_default: Conditions within normal range. No action needed; routine monitoring only.
MODERATE_rainfall: Current rainfall is the main driver. Monitor local drains, clear household outlets, and avoid parking in known low spots.
MODERATE_forecast: Forecast rainfall over the next 6 hours is the main driver. Plan travel before the rain window; keep devices charged.
MODERATE_water_level: Simulated water level is elevated above baseline. Watch lake and canal margins; avoid underpasses. (SIMULATED input.)
MODERATE_default: Monitor conditions. Review local drain status and follow IMD bulletins.
HIGH_rainfall: Heavy current rainfall relative to this zone's safe limit. Move vehicles to higher ground, avoid low-lying roads and subways, and secure ground-floor belongings.
HIGH_forecast: Significant rainfall forecast within 6 hours. Complete essential travel now; prepare sandbags or barriers for ground-floor entrances in known low spots.
HIGH_water_level: Simulated water level approaching the zone flood mark. Residents near lakes, canals and the river should prepare to move valuables upstairs. (SIMULATED input.)
HIGH_default: Elevated relative risk. Avoid low-lying roads, move vehicles to higher ground, and prepare for possible waterlogging.
CRITICAL_rainfall: Extreme current rainfall for this zone. Avoid all non-essential travel; do not drive through standing water. Follow Greater Chennai Corporation and NDMA/IMD advisories.
CRITICAL_forecast: Extreme rainfall forecast within 6 hours. Relocate from known flood-prone ground floors ahead of the rain window if local authorities advise; keep emergency contacts ready.
CRITICAL_water_level: Simulated water level at or above the zone flood mark. Treat lake, canal and river margins as hazardous; follow official evacuation guidance if issued. (SIMULATED input.)
CRITICAL_default: Very high relative risk. Avoid travel through this zone; follow instructions from Greater Chennai Corporation and NDMA/IMD advisories.
